note: Which harness each inference engine can be driven through. Editable and pullable reference data, exactly like subscriptions.json. Seeded so we don't re-probe what is already known; anything absent or null is PROBED, never refused.
rule: Always prefer the claude-cli harness. Use codex-cli only because an engine cannot speak the Anthropic Messages API — never as a preference.
codexRequiresResponsesApi: VERIFIED LIVE against codex 0.144.6: `wire_api = "chat"` is REJECTED at config load ('no longer supported', see openai/codex#7782). Codex now speaks ONLY the OpenAI RESPONSES API, so the codex harness can reach an engine only if it serves /v1/responses — serving /v1/chat/completions is NOT sufficient. This narrows the fallback considerably and is why several engines below have no harness at all until probed.

ollama.evidence: Anthropic: verified live here — POST /v1/messages returns authentically Anthropic-shaped JSON with real thinking blocks. Responses: verified live — POST /v1/responses does not answer (connection refused by the route), while /v1/chat/completions returns 200. Ollama needs no codex fallback anyway.

vllm.evidence: Anthropic: vllm/entrypoints/anthropic/ registered unconditionally; Claude Code integration documented (https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/serving/integrations/claude_code/). Responses: /v1/responses documented in the OpenAI-compatible server. Both harnesses work; claude-cli is preferred per the rule.

sglang.evidence: Anthropic /v1/messages is an open feature request, not shipped (https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/issues/9594). Responses API support is UNCONFIRMED — null, so the codex harness is probed rather than assumed. If neither answers, members still respond via a flattened completion.

trtllm.evidence: Neither endpoint confirmed in TRT-LLM's serving docs. Both null = probe both, in preference order.

openai.evidence: The Responses API is OpenAI's own; codex targets it natively.

xai.evidence: xAI is chat-completions-first; Responses support unconfirmed, so probe.

modelNotes.note: Chat working does NOT mean tool-calling works — the harness only executes calls it can parse, and models differ in tool-call dialect. These are known-quirk hints; the real answer is always the probe recorded in state.json.

toolDialectRisk.risk: emits native <|open|>tools markup as plain text instead of an executable tool call (observed live at high reasoning effort)
JSON-style tool calls that may not map onto the harness's expected tool_use blocks
tool-call dialect varies by build; probe before trusting web access
